subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should docs.openclaw.ai present latest-main docs with explicit version availability markers, track latest stable by default, or route release-specific guidance through bundled/version-matched docs?
rationale: The source mismatch is clear, but the durable fix changes docs publishing, release policy, and possibly config validation rather than a single implementation bug.

options.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
options.body: Publish or annotate docs so config keys are not presented as generally available before the release that accepts them.

options.title: Keep latest-main docs with recovery
options.body: Keep docs.openclaw.ai as latest-main but add prominent latest-only/version markers plus version-aware validation or doctor recovery for copied unsupported keys.

options.title: Defer to bundled docs track
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 as the main product path and keep this issue focused on public docs policy until that direction lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-aware public docs
recommendation.body: Publish or annotate docs so config keys are not presented as generally available before the release that accepts them.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest local history across the current docs/config mismatch example and docs publish workflow, and the remaining choice is a docs/release policy decision.
